**Finding: AUDIT — compliant (preferred level).**

§22.1–22.3 is the sole audit right binding us, and it satisfies all eight preferred elements: once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, off-site where practicable, Vendor-borne costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems. §22.3 adds protective language (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, shortfall payment resolves the issue). No redline proposed.
